'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals Mike d'Amboise LS Wesa Gotta Grand Army''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike d'Amboise]] at [[2010 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wesa Gotta Grand Army|Theed-L-wesagottagrandarmy.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Mike d'Ambrose
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
